text:
Ana: Quick retro on the two-way adapter pilot between LangChain/LlamaIndex and our gateway — can folks drop major takeaways and blockers?
Keith: Overall ✅ on compatibility. The bidirectional proxy worked, but we saw ~35-45% CPU increase on older A100 instances when KV cache warmup occurred. Needs tuning. :thinking_face:
Maria: Perf numbers please — can we get a 1-pager?
Samir: Uploaded the perf CSV and logs to s3://redwood-partners/lc-lindex-proxy/pilot-1987654321 — tag: pilot-run-4. Key point: tail latency spikes when concurrent streams > 8.
Emily: Noted. Also some customers care about model pinning semantics during orchestrator rollouts — we observed a mismatch in how LangChain session IDs map to our routing keys.
Jordan: That's the big compatibility surprise. We assumed session->route mapping would be preserved across the proxy; it isn't by default. Created a small shim to copy session_id into x-routing meta.
Keith: Shim patch looked good in staging. We should upstream a recommended adapter snippet. Minimal example: 
```
# gateway adapter snippet to propagate session id
headers = request.get_header('x-session-id')
if headers:
    request.set_meta('routing_key', headers)
```
Samir: Also flagged an edge-case where LlamaIndex async callbacks call back over a different websocket connection; KV cache mismatch unless we keep a global cache namespace.
Ana: Action item list? I'll compile. From me: 1) publish compatibility note (Emily + Ana) 2) upstream adapter example (Keith + Jordan) 3) perf follow-up (Samir) 4) SI enablement doc & checklist (Jordan + Emily) 5) announce pilot outcome with partners (Ana owns announcement).
Emily: I can draft announcement but we need the headline to be careful — emphasize "interop-ready" not "plug-and-play". Recommend a joint tech post + short marketplace blurb.
Jordan: For SI enablement, request: three short runbooks (deploy, debug, rollback) and a small terraform example for gateway routing. I'll start the runbooks and tag eng-ml for a quick review.
Keith: For hardware partners: we should recommend instance families that kept tail-latency stable — I'll prepare a small matrix (A100-v3, H100 small batch, T4 not recommended for high-concurrency).
Maria: Can we schedule a 30-min follow-up sync next Tues 10am PT to finalize announce copy + marketplace assets?
Ana: Yes — tentatively booked. @dev-bot can you paste the pilot summary (pass/fail matrix)?
dev-bot: Pilot summary: 4/5 integration scenarios passed. Failures: 1) async callback cache mismatch, 2) minor header mapping inconsistency (patched). Full log attached to the S3 path above.
Samir: Post-mortem note: we should add an e2e test exercising concurrent streaming > 8 to CI for adapters.
Emily: I'll own the announcement draft and the marketplace asset checklist. ETA EOD Wed for a first pass.
Ana: Great. Closing notes: keep messages short in the public post, include migration guide link, and list recommended instance families + known caveats. Thanks all :raised_hands:
